name: Spotify Downloader
author: specialkapa
description: Paste a Spotify or YouTube track, album or playlist link and download it as tagged MP3s with yt-dlp, then browse and play your downloads by genre, artist or playlist. Files are named 'artist - title (feat. artists).mp3' in lowercase. Network access only happens when you start a download.

barWidget.description: Download Spotify links as MP3s and play your library filtered by genre, artist or playlist. Click to open, right-click to download the Spotify link on the clipboard.

schema.label: Download folder
schema.description: Albums and playlists get their own subfolder here.

schema.label: Fallback genre
schema.description: Written when Deezer has no genre for the track, its album or its artist. Leave empty to write no genre.
